name: TOTP Enrollment Success
summary: Accepts a valid enrollment proof for the current authenticated identity, enables TOTP, and issues fresh recovery codes.

sourceState.expression: session-capability == authenticated-normal and TOTP enrollment is pending

guards.expression: the submitted TOTP code matches the staged authenticator secret and the timestep has not already been accepted

sourceReferences.note: ConfirmTotpEnrollmentAsync verifies the staged secret, enables TOTP, stores recovery codes, and returns those codes to the caller.
